OUTDATED MOD! Please note! I don´t plan on modding anymore. But if someone feels like it don't hesitate to change/update and reupload any of my files. I wouldn´t mind it.

[b]Includes:[/b]

Bunny (animated decor)
Hayrack 
Cute Pouf (useable as chair) 
Food Boxes
Rug

All items can be bought at Robins Carpenter Shop (also availabe via Furniture Catalogue).

A DGA version converted by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/124850573]NOAV7[/url] can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16552]here[/url].
[i]
[/i][b][i] [/i]
Installation: [/b]Just download the file and extract it to your mod folder.

Please note that items may conflict with other installed custom furniture if those were created with Platonymous Custom Furniture Mod! If this happens just open the bunnypack.json file and change the "id" number to something else that isn´t used yet (e.g. 40 to 401).
